Can the loader
keep up?

Try a hypothetical burst with the pieces already available. Adjust the scoring window and the loader’s measured or assumed time per piece.

5required pieces/s
2.5loader pieces/s

At this cadence, the loader can deliver 10 of 20 pieces in the window.

The usable window starts after travel and alignment. Check the supply available to one robot, possession rules and scoring positions in the actual game.

Can two loads run together?

In this invented trial, a carriage needs 9 V for one second. The fan uses the same supply. Change when it starts and compare the lowest voltage at the carriage inlet. A device with a voltage ceiling also needs a separate check at that inlet.

For your own design, put both trials on a common clock. The report identifies which loads drew current together, whether the evidence was modeled or measured and whether the action finished.
